# Ch'iVerve

> Landscape design meets agent engineering.

Official home of **Ch'iVerve**, the personal brand of [climashscape](https://github.com/climashscape) — where landscape architecture, AI agent tooling and open-source desktop apps grow from the same root: designing systems that feel alive.

<div align="center">

| | |
